MERGE INTO MST_SHARE_PRICE CII USING (
select #{item.sharesId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SHARES_ID, #{item.dealDate,jdbcType=DATE} DEAL_DATE, #{item.preClosePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} PRE_CLOSE_PRICE, #{item.openPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OPEN_PRICE, #{item.highPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} HIGH_PRICE, #{item.lowPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} LOW_PRICE, #{item.closePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CLOSE_PRICE, #{item.sShares,jdbcType=DECIMAL} S_SHARES, #{item.cShares,jdbcType=DECIMAL} C_SHARES, #{item.change,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CHANGE, #{item.changePercent,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CHANGE_PERCENT, #{item.dealValume,jdbcType=DECIMAL} DEAL_VALUME, #{item.dealAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL} DEAL_AMOUNT, #{item.avgPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AVG_PRICE, #{item.preClosePriceAdj,jdbcType=DECIMAL} PRE_CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ, #{item.openPriceAdj,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OPEN_PRICE_ADJ, #{item.highPriceAdj,jdbcType=DECIMAL} HIGH_PRICE_ADJ, #{item.lowPriceAdj,jdbcType=DECIMAL} LOW_PRICE_ADJ, #{item.closePriceAdj,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ, #{item.factorAdj,jdbcType=DECIMAL} FACTOR_ADJ, #{item.tradeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} TRADE_STATUS, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.SHARES_ID = TEMP.SHARES_ID AND CII.DEAL_DATE = TEMP.DEAL_DATE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
CII.PRE_CLOSE_PRICE = TEMP.PRE_CLOSE_PRICE, CII.OPEN_PRICE = TEMP.OPEN_PRICE, CII.HIGH_PRICE = TEMP.HIGH_PRICE, CII.LOW_PRICE = TEMP.LOW_PRICE, CII.CLOSE_PRICE = TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE, CII.S_SHARES = TEMP.S_SHARES, CII.C_SHARES = TEMP.C_SHARES, CII.CHANGE = TEMP.CHANGE, CII.CHANGE_PERCENT = TEMP.CHANGE_PERCENT, CII.DEAL_VALUME = TEMP.DEAL_VALUME, CII.DEAL_AMOUNT = TEMP.DEAL_AMOUNT, CII.AVG_PRICE = TEMP.AVG_PRICE, CII.PRE_CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ = TEMP.PRE_CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ, CII.OPEN_PRICE_ADJ = TEMP.OPEN_PRICE_ADJ, CII.HIGH_PRICE_ADJ = TEMP.HIGH_PRICE_ADJ, CII.LOW_PRICE_ADJ = TEMP.LOW_PRICE_ADJ, CII.CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ = TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ, CII.FACTOR_ADJ = TEMP.FACTOR_ADJ, CII.TRADE_STATUS = TEMP.TRADE_STATUS, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SHARES_ID,DEAL_DATE,PRE_CLOSE_PRICE,OPEN_PRICE,HIGH_PRICE,LOW_PRICE ,CLOSE_PRICE,S_SHARES,C_SHARES,CHANGE,CHANGE_PERCENT,DEAL_VALUME ,DEAL_AMOUNT, AVG_PRICE,PRE_CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ,OPEN_PRICE_ADJ,HIGH_PRICE_ADJ ,LOW_PRICE_ADJ,CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ,FACTOR_ADJ,TRADE_STATUS,CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values( TEMP.SHARES_ID,TEMP.DEAL_DATE,TEMP.PRE_CLOSE_PRICE,TEMP.OPEN_PRICE, TEMP.HIGH_PRICE,TEMP.LOW_PRICE,TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE,TEMP.S_SHARES,TEMP.C_SHARES, TEMP.CHANGE,TEMP.CHANGE_PERCENT,TEMP.DEAL_VALUME,TEMP.DEAL_AMOUNT, TEMP.AVG_PRICE,TEMP.PRE_CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ,TEMP.OPEN_PRICE_ADJ,TEMP.HIGH_PRICE_ADJ, TEMP.LOW_PRICE_ADJ,TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE_ADJ,TEMP.FACTOR_ADJ,TEMP.TRADE_STATUS, TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
